story.subtitle: Tiel-Coder with no thinking scores 38.5, 16.4 points under Clef-Flash BF16 (CI 12.7–20.4), at 0.93× its mean request time; a 256-token think per question with opt-in early exit lifts it to 49.0, 5.8 under (CI 2.6–9.5), at 4.1× the time.

fine_print.text: Decision Index 0.3 public subset: the 37 counted benchmarks (iSarcasmEval track A-En), kit 9eb2dbe2 and its unmodified scorer, suite sample --n 1480 --seed 20260919 (sha256 0ab3526d6a8e…), 33–34 linked groups per benchmark; not the board's Full score.

The Decision Index's balanced skill: chance-corrected benchmark scores averaged in five fixed-weight areas (the panels); chance levels are the index's own fixed values: per row for the accuracy, nDCG@10 and BFCL benchmarks, fixed for the F1 benchmarks and the benchmarks added in 0.2.

Rows over 16,384 Clef prompt tokens (n = 13) and any row not answered by every arm count as wrong for every arm (the index's no-truncation rule; all 13 are BRIGHT, 13 of its 33 groups, 17,112–32,805 tokens, length in the 32-document schema); Clef's own release code would refuse 12 of the 13 (“schema requires … tokens before state”) and truncate 1.

Answers each question in its own prompt (the state, then that question), so its prompts on the 13 BRIGHT rows (7,044 tokens at most) would fit its 16,384-token context; they still count as wrong for every arm.
Every arm +0.8 to +2.1 (the index's own re-weighting, the same draws); the order is unchanged and no paired CI changes whether it includes 0; Clef-Flash BF16 56.7.

157 rows (API-Bank 34, BANKING77 34, CLINC150+OOS 34, POP909-CL 33, ChessBench 22), none over 255 options; Callo (wide-choice readout) and Clef both answer up to 255 options, so every arm answers them. Plotted: treatment (a), kit-faithful; (b), unanswerable for every arm, is moot: no row exceeds Callo's 255-option limit, so it equals (a).

Callo answers a request's questions one at a time, reusing the state prefix (thinking per question at a budget above 0); Clef answers all of a row's questions in one joint pass; requests in the sampler's round-robin order, one at a time.

Opt-in in Callo (--think-converge, z .95): Callo stops a think once the answer has settled instead of using the whole budget. Tiel-Coder's line ends at think 256 with early exit: against plain think 256 on the same draws, index +0.2 [−2.0, +2.3] at 30 % less mean request time; the gate variant −0.8 [−2.9, +1.5] at 18 % less. Plain think 256 and the gate variant are in the table, not drawn. The gate first asks the model one zero-think question and sends multi-step rule problems to full thinking; on Flash-Next it sent 455 of 1,471 requests (31 %), and its read took about 1.1 s at the median on Flash-Next's long DI prompts. Paired vs Flash-Next no think: think 256 with early exit + gate +4.2 [+1.7, +6.8], at 3.2× the mean request time.
Request completion time, measured by one HTTP client that is the same for every arm, over the 1,467 rows answered by every arm: points at the mean, tails to the p95.
Clef 27B ran beside CPU-heavy test runs for its first ~1.5 h (~12:10–13:40 UTC on 2026-10-10) and was not re-timed, so its request time may read high.

Paired 95 % percentile bootstrap CIs of the difference vs Clef-Flash BF16 (1,000 resamples of linked groups within each benchmark, the same draws for every arm, the index's own scorer in the loop, seed 20260919). The difference vs Clef 27B is in the table only.

Tiel-Coder (no think, think 256) and Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B think 1024 ran before a readout fix (an end-of-turn token at the answer slot); their 66, 43 and 147 rows with an affected readout were re-read on the readout-fix build, and 40 unaffected rows per arm re-run as controls matched in status, bit for bit on Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B.
Tiel-Coder and Flash-Next are MoE models; on the unified KV cache Callo's llama-server runs, their runs are not bit-reproducible (Tiel-Coder's re-read controls: 12 and 2 of 40 rows bit for bit).
The 0.3 board's public index for “Cloudflare clef” is 61.71 (full suite, authors' runtime); Clef's card reports 0.2.1 full-suite numbers.

Callo 0.3.0 development builds: the first build (Tiel-Coder no think and think 256; Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B think 1024), the refit build (Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B no think), the early-exit build (Flash-Next no think) and the gate build (the early-exit points); without early exit their behaviour is byte-identical, but for the readout fix the re-read covers; --cache on (default); llama.cpp b50-4ebdf2c (Callo), b11379 1537a0a8 (Clef) and 23deec02 (d1); Tiel-Coder budgets 512 and 1024 not run on DI (only 0 and 256); Sharp-MiniCPM5-2B budgets 256 and 512 not run on DI (only 0 and 1024); Apple M2 Ultra, 64 GB, one request at a time; run Callo 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-13, Clef 2026-10-10, d1 2026-10-14 (UTC).
